# FocusMaster Application

FocusMaster is a modern productivity application designed to help users enter deep work sessions, manage tasks, and track productivity. It features a built-in Pomodoro timer, smart task manager, focus analytics, calendar, and Spotify integration.

- [Dashboard](https://focusmaster-tau.vercel.app/dashboard) - Access your productivity tools (requires login).

## Application Architecture

The application is built using React, TypeScript, and Vite on the frontend, featuring state management via Zustand and styling with TailwindCSS. The UI relies on Radix UI primitives and Framer Motion for animations. The backend utilizes a scalable Node.js/Express architecture.

## Accessibility & SEO

FocusMaster is optimized for screen readers and agentic browsing, ensuring full ARIA compatibility, clear heading hierarchy, and performance-first image loading via WebP formatting.
